gallery.title: File:Escritoire desk (AM 2013.34.1-14).jpg
gallery.description: The escritoire consists of a knee-hole desk with a set of four drawers each side of the knee-hole and a superstructure of a large central cupboard, a set of four small drawers each side of the cupboard and each enclosed by a door, and a writing slide below the central cupboard. The whole is inlaid with pictorial scenes featuring Maori and a scene of Auckland Harbour, ferns and other representations of New Zealand flora. Motifs inspired by features from Maori art also occur. All are in such exquisite detail that it has been possible to identify the plants and source of pictorial features. Decorative carvings on the superstructure and in the knee-hole are also a feature of the desk.

gallery.title: File:Mafeking Bell, Mount Morgan, Queensland.jpg
gallery.description: The Mafeking Bell in the main street of Mount Morgan, Queensland. Plaque reads: "This bell was cast in 1900 from pennies donated by Mount Morgan school children to commemorate The Relief of Mafeking. The defence of Mafeking was under the command of - Lord Baden-Powell who later founded the Boy Scout Movement. Presented by the Mount Morgan Shire Council October 1962." (note misspelling of 'defense').

gallery.filename: General J.P. Snyman with General Piet Cronje and Captain of the Transvaal State-Artillery, P.J. van der Merwe.png
gallery.title: File:General J.P. Snyman with General Piet Cronje and Captain of the Transvaal State-Artillery, P.J. van der Merwe.png
gallery.description: Taken in the early days of the siege, shows General Piet Cronje (afterwards captured at Paardeberg), whip in hand, standing at the breech of the 94-pounder "Long Tom" nicknamed "Creechy" (abbreviation for Marguerite), or "Creaky," which had frequent duels with the little Nordenfeldt. On his right, pipe in mouth, is Assistant General J.P. Snyman, and on his left is Captain of the Transvaal State-Artillery, P.J. van der Merwe.

gallery.title: File:Second Boer War Collage.png
gallery.artist: The British Army and The Illustrated London News
gallery.description:
A Collage of Major Battles and Events during the Second Boer War
Clockwise from left:

Boers in action at the Battle of Colenso, the 17th Lancers holding of an attack at Modderfontein, General Redvers Buller entering Ladysmith on 27 Feb 1900, Boers at the besieged city of Mafeking, Canadian Troops during the Battle of Paardeberg, and Boers before action at Spion Kop.
